subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be narrowed to the `heartbeat.session` precedence bug while preserving the current `dmScope: main` Telegram DM default, or should OpenClaw intentionally change Telegram DM default isolation?
rationale: Current docs and tests define main-session DM sharing as the default, but the issue also contains a valid heartbeat-session precedence bug; automation cannot safely choose the compatibility boundary.

options.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
options.body: Make configured `heartbeat.session` win for system-event-triggered wakes and preserve current Telegram DM defaults, with separate docs or issue work for default isolation.

options.title: Change Telegram DM default isolation
options.body: Treat Telegram DMs as isolated by default, but require an explicit compatibility and migration decision because this changes documented current behavior.

options.title: Revive the existing fix branch unchanged
options.body: Continue from the conflicting linked branch if maintainers accept its broader event-migration shape and resolve the product-boundary risk during review.

recommendation.title: Fix heartbeat precedence only
recommendation.body: Make configured `heartbeat.session` win for system-event-triggered wakes and preserve current Telegram DM defaults, with separate docs or issue work for default isolation.

likelyOwner.reason: frankbuild supplied the strongest reproduction and owns the direct unmerged fix branch that maintainers would likely review or narrow.
